source: CADaddy's own accuracy-trend tolerances (Q6193): how far each measured number of one build (validate.measure) may move against the build before it, and in which direction it gets worse. Tightened from the spread of repeat runs of one build: the deterministic checks (Gate A, prescreen, coverage, takeoff, counts) repeat exactly, so their tolerances only absorb rounding and small reading changes; the job time and peak memory vary with the machine's load.
